title: M1.6: Email outbound rendering
description:
Render a committed message to email: Message-ID on our mail domain, In-Reply-To and References chain (capped), Subject reuse with a single Re prefix, plain-text body plus minimal sanitized HTML, From as the bot address with the bot name as display name, Reply-To the same, Auto-Submitted auto-replied, X-Chatticus-Origin and X-Chatticus-Hops, plus-tag correlator. Record every sent Message-ID in the emsg index. Never include internal ids, tool output or workspace paths beyond what the bot wrote.

Acceptance criteria:
- Rendered mail threads correctly in the fake mail client scenario (reply chain preserved across three exchanges)
- Headers present exactly as specified; hop counter increments from the inbound value
- Subject and display name are injection safe (no header injection through bot names or subjects)
- Body over the limit is truncated with a link to the web channel

Gherkin: features/email_message_rendering.feature

Depends on: M1.4, M1.5

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Known gap from M1.5 review: define the outbound Message-ID format here, then add the inbound check that drops and counts a message whose Message-ID is one of our own outbound ids (docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.md known gaps). Until then only the X-Chatticus-Origin header marks our own mail; X-Chatticus-Hops above 3 is subsumed by that header.

comments.text: PR 646 open into develop (not merged). Built: render (plain text, bot address to sender only, In-Reply-To and References, single Re, injection-safe subject, Auto-Submitted, X-Chatticus-Origin and Hops, plus tag on Reply-To, 100k cut with web link), outbound Message-ID chatticus.<token>.<mark>@<mail domain> with HMAC mark, inbound refusal own_outbound_message_id (closes the known gap), deliver over an injected SES v2 client port with classified failures, SES event parsing via SNS into delivered/bounced/complained with per-binding recipient suppression (Dynamo store). Gates: tsc, vitest 1420, infra 890, cucumber 2206 of 2228 (22 failures are web-harness scenarios, react-markdown not installed in this worktree). Not done or open: SES may rewrite Message-ID (verify in live smoke test), References is root plus parent only (port lacks the chain), complaint is binding-scope only, no real SES SDK client yet (M1.8). delivery.ts now passes the channel name as the thread subject.
